name: Video Global Illumination
algorithm: Video Global Illumination — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes global illumination consistency for video deepfake detection:

1. **照明Environment推定**: The scene's illumination environment is estimated per frame from multiple cues: shadow directions and intensities, specular highlights, ambient illumination level, and color temperature. This builds a per-frame lighting model.

2. **顔-Scene照明Agreement**: The illumination on the face should be consistent with the estimated scene illumination. The method compares: (a) light direction on the face vs. scene shadows, (b) ambient-to-direct illumination ratio on face vs. scene, (c) color temperature of face illumination vs. scene. Deepfakes generated under different lighting won't match the scene.

3. **Inter-Object照明一貫性**: All objects in the scene (including the face) should show consistent illumination from the same light sources. The method checks illumination consistency across multiple objects — if the face shows different lighting than a nearby object at similar distance from the light source, manipulation is indicated.

4. **グローバル照明Effects**: Natural scenes show secondary illumination effects: color bleeding (colored surfaces tint nearby surfaces), ambient occlusion (corners and crevices are darker), and environmental reflections. The method checks whether these global illumination effects are present and consistent between the face and scene. AI generators often don't model these subtle inter-object light interactions.

5. **時間的照明コヒーレンス**: Scene illumination should change smoothly and affect all objects simultaneously. The method tracks illumination parameters over time — face illumination should correlate with scene illumination changes. Independent illumination variation on the face indicates it was generated separately from the scene.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through 動画 global illumination analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
